extraction.text:
JAVED H SHAH

Network Engineer | 9 years’ experience |. • Troubleshooting Expert

Phone: +91- 9881822332 Email: onlyjs99@yahoo.com

LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/javed-shah

Address: House no-17, Bharat Nagar, at post- BIDKIN, Aurangabad, Maharashtra, India, Pin code- 431105

SUMMARY

Experienced network engineer skilled in managing and troubleshooting complex systems, adept at solving critical issues under pressure. Proficient in various protocols, I aim to leverage my expertise to contribute to a dynamic organization.

KEY ACHIEVEMENTS

Uptime Excellence

2000+ Issues Resolved

Deployment Leadership

Managed network devices with minimum downtime incidents over past years.

Successfully resolved over 2000 complex network issues, enhancing total stability by 40%.

Led a team in configuring 100+ network upgrades with a 100% successful deployment rate.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Engineer, Core Operations

01/2022 – 06/2026

GTT Communications

Pune, India

Supporting Juniper devices MX480/MX960, EX4200/EX4300/EX4500.

Device up-gradation & Part replacement like Routing-engine, FPC, RE, PEM, SCB.

Protocol config/Tshoot: MPLS, BGP, OSPF, EIGRP, RIP, Static/Default, BFD, RSVP, LAG.

Resolved link flapping issues, packet drops, device reboots, and various hardware-related issues.

Configured L2circuit/VLAN and VPLS.

Involved JTAC for RCA & complex issues; created RMA & part returning processes.

Conducted intrusive testing like MAC-SWAP-LOOP test & RFC2544 Testing.

Configured and installed Accedian NID.

Supported services: IP Transit, VPLS, Ethernet & Internet direct, NNI, Peering & Private Line.

Worked with field engineers remotely to troubleshoot & resolve customer issues.

Network Engineer

07/2017 - 01/2022

IBM India Pvt. Ltd

Pune, India

Configured and troubleshoot protocols: MPLS, BGP, OSPF, EIGRP, RIP.

Collected and analyzed logs for issue diagnosis/resolution.

Managed Juniper devices: M10i, M120, MX240/MX480/MX960, EX4200/EX4300/EX4500.

Managed Cisco routers and switches: ASR series, ISR series, Catalyst series.

Performed daily health check-ups on core devices.

Worked under pressure for service restoration and issue resolution.

Handled core network-related issues, like link flapping and packet drops.

Raised TAC cases based on service impacts and collaborated with Juniper TAC team.

Conducted device upgrades and arranged joint calls with ATAC and clients.

Provided RFQ/RCA to customers for service impacts.

1 / 2

IT Specialist

06/2015 - 05/2017

Bajaj Auto Ltd

Waluj, Aurangabad, India

Configured and troubleshoot connectivity issues of protocols: RIP, EIGRP, OSPF.

Provided field support for network device installation and upgradation.

Handled escalation cases and provided RCA; created GRE tunnels, VPNs.

Installed and configured routers, switches, and access points.

Configured EtherChannel, port security, and VTP.

Handled CCTV installation and network printer troubleshooting.

Set up internet connectivity solutions and office branch setups.

Hardware & Network Engineer

07/2014 - 08/2015

SABMiller India Ltd (A global brewing company)

Aurangabad, India

Troubleshot networking issues: TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, Layer 2/3 devices.

Configured VLANs and secure network with port security.

Configured and tested multi-node networks using routers and switches.

Managed internet connection sharing, driver installations, and DNS/DHCP configurations.

Resolved operating system and software problems.

Performed user management, system backup, and restore.

TECHNICAL SKILLS

Routing/Switching: MPLS, BGP, OSPF, EIGRP, RIP, VLAN, VRRP, LACP, HSRP, VLAN, STP, VTP, Etherchannel.

Hardware/Vendors:

Juniper (MX- 204/240/480/960, EX- 2300/4200/4300/4600, M10i, M120),

Cisco (2800 Series) , (ASR 1000, ISR 900,1000, | Catalyst Switch 4500-X, 9500, 9600)

Protocols & Core:

TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, IPv4, IPv6, NTP, SSH, Telnet, TFTP, SMTP, ARP.

Others:

Service -Now, CMD, Solarwind, WeatherMap, Wireshark, WIFI | ACL |

Subnetting | Ethernet networks | password recovery.

CERTIFICATIONS

STRENGTHS

Cisco CCNA V 3.0 (Verification ID: CSCO13493762)

Eager Learner: Fast & adaptable.

Juniper JNCIA (Verification ID: JN0-103-JPR00305494)

Team Player: Works well under pressure.

Cisco CCNP Course Completed

Confidence: Driven & determined.

EDUCATION

LANGUAGES

English
